summary: The exact dependence-safe conditional Hausdorff-Young budget is valid: for q>=2, p=q/(q-1), h the density of D=X-X', and psi_d the conditional characteristic function of S=X+X' given D=d, int h(d)^q int|psi_d(u)|^q du dd <= pi. However, immediately applying Minkowski in d and paying the reciprocal coefficient absolutely produces H_{p,q}(f)=int J_p(d)^(1/p)|d|^(-1/q)dd, which is not uniformly finite over cap-one densities. A fragmented indicator density with interval lengths a_k~1/[k(log k)^(1+eps)], eps<=p-1, makes this functional diverge. This refutes only that conditional-HY-then-Minkowski closure, not the QFORM conjecture or the averaged conditional HY lemma. Future use must average before reciprocal coefficient payment, e.g. TT*/volume aggregation.
